name: Regenerate new hair follicles in a healed wound
description: After a large full-thickness wound, new hair follicles form de novo in the healed skin, as in embryonic development.

grade.note: Wound-induced hair neogenesis occurs in adult mice after large excisional wounds and is Wnt-dependent (Ito 2007); the neogenic follicles then drive myofibroblast-to-adipocyte conversion (Plikus 2017). No report of de novo follicle neogenesis in adult human wounds located.
grade.drift: 'Mice regrow hair after wounding' is often generalised to humans; the human observation is absent.

wouldMove: Documented follicle neogenesis (not follicle survival) in an adult human wound, by any group.
